bullet: Cold reads do not load a conversation (`F04.read-no-hydrate`).
script:
LEASE="$AGENT_SERVER_VERIFY_RUN/server/workspace/conversations/${IID//-/}/owner_lease.json"
test ! -e "$LEASE"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$IID" --expect 200 --check id eq "$IID" --quiet
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie> --query ids="$IID" --check 0.id eq "$IID" --quiet
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/search --query status=idle --check items contains "$IID" --quiet
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/count --query status=idle --check . ge 1
test ! -e "$LEASE"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$IID/agent_final_response" --expect 200 --check response eq '' --save F04.read-no-hydrate/final-response
test -f "$LEASE"
